description: This file defines the TemplateURL class, which extends TemplateText, representing a URL field in the SuiteCRM system. It includes methods for generating HTML for editing and viewing URL fields, processing the URL value, and providing the field definition for database and application use.

classes.name: TemplateURL
classes.description: A class that represents a URL type field in the SuiteCRM framework, providing methods for rendering HTML, processing URLs, and defining database schema details.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object and maps vardef fields 'ext4' and 'link_target' to each other.

methods.name: get_html_edit
methods.description: Returns the HTML input element for editing the URL field.

methods.name: get_html_detail
methods.description: Returns the HTML for displaying the URL as a clickable link.

methods.name: get_xtpl_detail
methods.description: Processes the URL value for display, prepending 'http://' if the URL lacks a scheme.

methods.name: get_field_def
methods.description: Provides the field definition array for database schema, including default values and field properties.
